root.label: Dutch Bros opens first walk-up-only location near USC

events.label: Dutch Bros opens first walk-up-only location near USC

slots.name: number of windows
slots.sentence: The location—which features three windows, for ordering, pickup and mobile orders—had the highest sales volume of any Dutch Bros coffee shop until May, when it was surpassed by the opening of the first Chicago-area location, according to Chief Financial Officer Josh Guenser.

slots.name: opening date
slots.sentence: The company opened its first walk-up-only location in November near the University of Southern California in Los Angeles, in what it describes as a test of the concept.
